name: WF4 — Deliver QR (on demand)

nodes.name: Deliver QR Webhook
nodes.notes: POST https://n8n.uniongloss.com/webhook/deliver-qr?code=LAT-XXXXXX. responseNode: 401 for a bad admin secret, 200 otherwise, without waiting for QR/email work.

parameters.query: SELECT o.id AS order_id, o.code, o.buyer_email, o.buyer_name, p.id AS page_id, p.slug FROM orders o JOIN pages p ON p.order_id = o.id WHERE o.code = ($1::jsonb #>> '{}');

nodes.name: Stop: Not Found
nodes.notes: TODO(alert): notify admin when the code has no page.

nodes.name: Admin Secret Valid?
nodes.notes: true = shared secret matches -> continue; false -> 401 and stop.

nodes.name: Respond Accepted
nodes.notes: Requires the Webhook node responseMode = responseNode. Responds immediately, the run keeps going.

nodes.name: Respond Unauthorized
nodes.notes: Requires the Webhook node responseMode = responseNode. Responds immediately, the run keeps going.

nodes.name: Stop: Unauthorized
nodes.notes: Invalid admin secret. Response 401 already sent.

_comment: Webhook to re-send the surprise URL + QR for a given order code. Call it with ?code=LAT-XXXXXX (query or JSON body) and header x-latido-secret = $env.LATIDO_ADMIN_SECRET; a bad secret returns 401 (responseMode=responseNode). Postgres values are parameterized.
